$comment: Desktop plugins: git repositories Marvi clones, updates and runs as gateway sidecars. Distinct from skills (prompts) and MCP servers (external tool processes) — a plugin ships a long-running backend and registers tools against it. Nothing in the code knows the name of a specific plugin; this file is the whole list.

plugins.name: smart_room
plugins.title: Smart Room
plugins.why: Presence fusion, Tuya LAN control, automations and room history. Owns every device; Marvi is a client.
plugins.$comment_ref: Empty follows the repository's own default branch, whatever it is called. Name a branch or a tag here to pin the plugin instead.
